Cross reference—
Any ordinance or resolution dedicating, naming, establishing, locating, relocating,
               opening, paving, widening, repairing, vacating, etc., any street or public way saved
               from repeal, § 1-10(a)(5); any ordinance establishing and prescribing the street grades of any street
               saved from repeal, § 1-10(a)(10); any ordinance providing for local improvements and assessing taxes for such
               improvements saved from repeal, § 1-10(a)(11); buildings and building regulations, ch. 18; environment, ch. 38; smoking in public places, § 38-301 et seq.; overflow of water on streets, etc., § 50-25; motor vehicles and traffic,
               ch. 54; urination and defecation in public, § 62-57; sales and solicitation near or on streets and highways prohibited, § 62-62; parks and recreation, ch. 66; planning and development, ch. 74; public improvements, ch. 78; utilities, ch. 102; zoning districts, pt. III, art. 4; use regulations, pt. III, art. 5; development
               standards, pt. III, art. 6; subdivision regulations and improvements, pt. III, art.
               7.
State Law reference—
General power of city council as to streets and alleys, C.R.S. § 31-15-702; public
               improvements generally, C.R.S. § 31-25-101 et seq.; acceptance and improvement of
               streets, C.R.S. § 31-23-217; improvements in city and towns, C.R.S. § 31-35-303 et
               seq.; city highways, C.R.S. § 43-2-101 et seq.
